content.comment_body: Import of a technical question via private message from [user_name] Hi [user_name], I have a question about the [product_name] software license. If a customer buys one DVD, can it be installed on several computers at the same time with a full license? If so, what do '1 INSTALLATION' and 'Single license' mean according to the product description? Thank you in advance.
A single license indicates that the software can only be installed on one device (PC or laptop). Each additional device requires its own separate license and DVD.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarification on what 'single license' and '1 INSTALLATION' mean for [product_name] software, specifically questioning whether a single DVD allows full licensed use on multiple computers. The reply explains that each license is limited to a single device, and extra installations require individual purchases. This exchange highlights possible confusion for customers regarding how licensing terms are presented.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward definitions and clearer explanations of licensing terms, as well as potentially more flexible installation options for each purchase.
